intro: Everyone rides a bike of light that leaves a solid wall behind it. Hit any wall, yours included, and you're out.
inspiredBy: Trail games like this go back to the arcades of the late 1970s and early 80s; the best known is the race in the film Tron (1982). Neon Trails is our own take.
goal: Be the last one riding to take the round. The first to win the set number of rounds (3, 5 or 7) wins the match.
howToPlay: Join with your phone, or play on your own against the computer riders.
In the lobby, choose how many computer riders to add and how many rounds it takes to win, then press ✕ to start.
After the countdown, you move on your own. Turn with the arrows: one tap, one turn. You can't turn straight back on yourself.
Steer so that others run into your wall, and keep yourself out of theirs.
When someone crashes, their wall disappears, opening up the board again.
After 25 seconds the walls start closing in from the edges, so every round ends soon.
steering: Turn left, right, up or down
tips: Cut across in front of a rider to box them in.
Boost to get ahead of someone, then turn across their path.
Hold Brake to squeeze through a gap, or to let someone pass before you turn.
Space matters more than speed: stay near open parts of the board.
